notes: All frames, markers and mass properties of the SONAIR two-mode kit v2 (mm, g). The assembly STLs are in these frames and import directly into MuJoCo. Replace printed-part masses after weighing; the CAD centres of mass can be kept.

frames.F: UR5e tool flange (tool0): origin at the centre of the flange face, z along the tool. The 2F-85 mounts directly on the flange; closed to 27.0 mm between the pads.
frames.C: Camera tool: coincides with F when held by the gripper (Mode B)
frames.D: Dock: C when the camera tool is docked (z of C pointing down)
frames.S: Specimen or paddle: origin at the centre of the underside, x along the long side, y along the short side (handle at -y), z up; the defect ground-truth CSV uses this frame
frames.K: Riser: coincides with S of the part on it
frames.G: D435i optical frame (RealSense convention: x right, y down, z forward), origin at the left imager
frames.A: D405 optical frame (same convention), origin at the left imager
frames.J: P09 Jetson acquisition plate: origin at the centre of its underside, x parallel to x of base B; placed at (-250, -180, 0) mm in B

measurement_chain.modeA: T_A_S(t) = T_A_B . T_B_F(t) . T_F_S; T_A_B from the docked camera's hand-eye calibration (K4b), T_B_F(t) from RTDE, T_F_S measured per frame by the D435i (T_F_G . T_G_S)
measurement_chain.modeB: T_A_S(t) = inv(T_C_A) . inv(T_B_F(t)) . T_B_S; T_F_C measured per frame by the D435i from the camera tool's tags, T_C_A from K4a, T_B_S from the locating pins and K6
measurement_chain.segment_attribution: RTDE gives B->F; the D435i gives F->S (Mode A) or F->C (Mode B); the D405 gives A->S; the loop closure error = arm deflection + grasp slip + calibration error, and IMU-F / IMU-C / IMU-P / IMU-T give the matching high-frequency parts

D435i_in_F.axes: D435i x (long side) -> F +x, D435i y (top) -> F +y, view -> F +z
D435i_in_F.note: Datasheet: left imager 17.5 mm from the 1/4-20 centre line, front glass Z' = -4.2 mm; from the Intel model the left imager is on the +x side of F. Exact value from K4c.
D435i_in_F.mount: 2 x M3 x 6 into the back holes (45 mm apart), 0.4 N m
D435i_in_F.emitter: must be off (the D405 is passive stereo; a projected pattern would change its data)

D405_in_C.insert_rule: USB port into the large window on the camera tool's +y side; from the Intel model the 1/4-20 hole falls on the +x wall (the -x wall is drilled too; the part decides)
D405_in_C.note: Datasheet: left imager 9 mm from the 1/4-20 centre line, 3.7 mm behind the front glass. From the Intel model the left imager is on the USB side (+y of C). Exact value from K4a.

IMU.type: SparkFun SEN-21325 (LSM6DSV16X), chip at the board centre, 1.6 mm board; IMU-C2 and IMU-P at 0x6A, the others 0x6B; on the Jetson's two I2C buses (see jetson_acquisition)

virtual_IMU_C.formula: a = (a_C1 + a_C2) / 2, omega the mean of both (after aligning to C with K2)

IMU-P.note: one on S2 and one on S4, same position

AprilTag.convention: T_part_tag follows the AprilTag 3 convention: origin at the tag centre, x right along the pattern, y down, z into the tag. The OpenCV aruco convention (y up, z out) is this one rotated 180 deg about x.

0.paste_rule: on the small plate on the -y face, pattern upright (top of the image towards +z)

1.paste_rule: on the small plate on the -y face, pattern upright (top of the image towards +z)

2.paste_rule: on the small plate on the -y face, pattern upright (top of the image towards +z)

3.paste_rule: on the small plate on the -y face, pattern upright (top of the image towards +z)

4.paste_rule: on the small plate on the -y face, pattern upright (top of the image towards +z)

5.paste_rule: on the small plate on the -y face, pattern upright (top of the image towards +z)

10.paste_rule: on the face of the -y ledge that faces the gripper, top of the pattern towards the ledge's outer edge (-y)

11.paste_rule: on the face of the -y ledge that faces the gripper, top of the pattern towards the ledge's outer edge (-y)

ChArUco.note: board origin at its first corner; positions refined by calibration

modeA_handle_to_flange.note: x_F = x_S; y_F = 13.2 - z_S; z_F = y_S + 251.15. Same for S2, S4 and the paddle handle.

dock_in_D.profile: 30 x 30 aluminium profile; the P02 key is 5.8 mm wide (fits 6 mm or 8 mm slots); M5 screws with matching M5 T-nuts; profile centre at y = 107 in D

jetson_acquisition.position: P09 plate centred at (-250, -180, 0) mm in the base frame; Jetson developer kit centre at (0, -52, 5) in J
jetson_acquisition.I2C bus 1 (40-pin header pins 27/28): QwiicBus arm cable -> IMU-F (0x6B) -> IMU-P (0x6A) in Mode A

I2C bus 7 (40-pin header pins 3/5).Mux channel 0: QwiicBus camera tool cable -> IMU-C1 (0x6B) -> IMU-C2 (0x6A)
I2C bus 7 (40-pin header pins 3/5).Mux channel 1: QwiicBus riser cable -> IMU-T (0x6B) -> IMU-P (0x6A) in Mode B

jetson_acquisition.address_jumpers: IMU-C2 and both IMU-P boards set to 0x6A; all others 0x6B
jetson_acquisition.network: Jetson, UR control box (RTDE) and the lab PC on one gigabit switch
